_help: Act 1, encounter B, at Freddie's office after the debt collectors: armed men looking for Freddie (or what he left) think you're in on it. With musa_respect, Musa is one of them and won't shoot; talking them down works if Umm Sayed warned you about Finch (warned_finch: the police watch Finch's building); giving them Freddie's note (freddie_note) sends them to Alexandria (freddie_betrayed). Freddie owes their employer 200: offering the 20 in your pockets doesn't buy them off; they keep it (armed_took_money) and press you again. Avoided: act1_confrontation_done + act1_gunfight_avoided (end_avoided). Drawing: event fight_armed_men (end_fight; the gun tutorial): on a win act1.gd sets act1_gunfight_won + act1_confrontation_done. Generated by tools/dialogue/make_act1.py.

start.speaker: gunman
start.line: Nobody move. You're Mallory's friend. Where is he? He owes our employer two thousand pounds, and he took something that isn't his. We think you know where.

musa_there.speaker: musa
musa_there.line: Wait. This one... this one helped me stand up. He knows nothing. I do not shoot him.

musa_leaves.speaker: gunman
musa_leaves.line: Musa! You fool! ...Fine. Fine! Tell Mallory we're still looking.

talk_down.speaker: player
talk_down.line: Three of them in Freddie's doorway. Pistols out. The leader's hand isn't steady.

choices.label: Talk him down
choices.line: You don't want this. This is Finch's building, and the police watch everything Finch owns. One shot and they're on the stairs. Walk away.

choices.label: Give them the note
choices.line: He's in Alexandria. Here's his note. Go and ask him yourself.

choices.label: Offer what you have
choices.line: Two hundred pounds. It's all I've got. Take it and go.

talk_works.speaker: gunman
talk_works.line: ...Police. Right. Finch's building. You're Finch's problem, not ours. Let's go.

pocketed.speaker: gunman
pocketed.line: Two hundred. Mallory owes two thousand, and you offer me lunch money. I'll keep it, for the insult. Now: where is he?

choices.label: Talk him down
choices.line: Think about it. One shot in Finch's building and the police are on the stairs.

choices.label: Give them the note
choices.line: All right. Alexandria. Here's his note.

choices.label: Offer what you have
choices.line: Two hundred pounds. It's all I've got.

note.speaker: gunman
note.line: Alexandria. There, that wasn't so hard. Come on.

avoided.speaker: player
avoided.line: Footsteps going down the stairs. My hand's still on the revolver.
